subject: AuroraHealth SIG follow-up: BCP artifacts & RTO/RPO clarifications
messages:
From: Jamie Lee <jamie.lee@aurorahealth.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-09-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: BCP/SIG follow-up: RTO/RPO artifacts needed

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the SIG call this morning. AuroraHealth is progressing our intake and we need a focused set of BCP/DR artifacts for the RPO/RTO assessment team. Specifically can you provide: 

- The most recent runbook snapshot describing failover steps (including who performs each step).
- A concise RTO/RPO matrix by service/component (ideally CSV) and the assumptions behind each number.
- Warm-cache / KV-cache warm-up timings observed during last warm start (sample traces or logs are fine).
- Contact list / key-holder manifest for escalation during a DR event.

Also let us know if you can support a 30-minute witness call (screen-share) week of Sep 27 to walk through a restore trace. If there are known exceptions (e.g., archived datasets with longer restore times) flag them.

If helpful, we can accept redacted logs or an ops-runbook export. Please indicate any items that are on a different cadence (quarterly exercises, etc.).

Thanks,
Jamie
Jamie Lee
Sr. Security Engineer, AuroraHealth
security@aurorahealth.com

Attachment: SIG-questionnaire-worksheet.xlsx (referenced)

From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Date: 2027-09-18T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BCP/SIG follow-up: RTO/RPO artifacts needed

Jamie — thanks for the clear list and for joining the call earlier. We can provide all of the items you requested. Quick clarifications so we send the right format: 

1) RTO/RPO matrix: we'll export component-level numbers (model serving, embeddings index, metadata DB, object store restore time). Is CSV ok (one row per component) and do you want an accompanying row explaining recovery steps?

2) Warm-cache traces: we have KV cache warm-up logs from our last warm start on 2027-09-16. Those are redacted for IPs and internal hostnames; is that acceptable?

3) Witness call: week of Sep 27 works. We propose Tue 2027-09-28 10:00 AM PT — does that fit Aurora's schedule? We'll plan for a 30-minute demo + 15 min Q&A.

We'll attach a runbook snapshot, the RTO/RPO CSV, and a condensed trace file in our follow-up. Priyom (ops) will take point on assembling artifacts and can include the key-holder manifest and recovery contact list.

Deliverable timeline: artifacts sent by EOD 2027-09-21, witness call calendar invite to follow. If any items are restricted for legal/compliance reasons we'll note them inline.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Trust & Safety (Compliance)
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
